dse_runs.notes: System spec: 32 requests/us bursty (all 32 at once per 1us tick), p99 batch latency <= 0.44us. Need throughput >= 32 Msps and err <= 2^-12. Minimise LUTs+FFs, maximise accuracy_bits. Screen with the analytic batch bound at L1, then L2-simulate the shortlist. Prefer designs with enough parallel lanes / pipelined throughput to meet the burst deadline, not just average throughput.

selected_facts.dds_provenance: simulated (hw_dse.l2.dds l2-v1: golden-model DDS, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT, tone bin 1297)

l2.why: the L1 selection passes the simulated system constraints

l3: not verified in this campaign: no recorded L3 row; a fresh exhaustive run (W=17) is too heavy for a live campaign
l4: no recorded synthesis for this design (L4 is not run live in campaigns)
final_text: The single spec in the queue, `multiaxis_control` (16-axis shared sin/cos, 32 requests per 1 µs tick, p99 batch ≤ 0.44 µs, err ≤ 2⁻¹², min LUTs+FFs), is finalized. L1 `run_dse` spent the full 400-evaluation budget (100/round, 4 rounds, eps 0.01) and produced a 25-design feasible, non-dominated front, all of the `pipelined_m` family with m=4 lanes; the L1 selection rule (min luts_plus_ffs) picked `pipelined_m:data_width=17,n_iter=16,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=round,m=4` at luts_plus_ffs=1175 (luts=906, ffs=268), accuracy_bits=12, max_abs_err=0.000244 (2⁻¹²·⁰⁰, exact golden-model), throughput_msps=97.8 (estimate), sys_p99_batch_us=0.368 (analytic bound). L2 `simulate_system` on the top 6 confirmed every candidate passes the simulated system constraint, with the winner's p99 batch latency tightening from the 0.3679 bound to 0.378 µs simulated — still comfortably under 0.44 µs — and the winner unchanged. L3/L4/L5 via the ladder sub-agent returned no recorded RTL verdict or synthesis row for this configuration (the RTL generator is verified on 47 other configs; L4 is never run live), and `back_annotate` reported `no_measured_data` with **no winner change**, so `reexplore` was correctly not triggered. The spec is closed on the L2-checked selection: `pipelined_m:data_width=17,n_iter=16,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=round,m=4` — luts_plus_ffs=1175, accuracy_bits=12, luts=906, ffs=268, throughput_msps=97.8, max_abs_err=0.000244, sys_p99_batch_us=0.378 (simulated), with all cost/timing figures carrying estimate/simulated provenance rather than measured.
